lines.zh: 我沿着林子的上空滑过去。
lines.en: I glide over the treetops of the wood.

lines.zh: 丛林太密，我只能飞在树梢。
lines.en: The jungle is too thick, so I keep above it.
I skim a stand of palms.
I head for the hills where the wind is better.
My wings spread wide.

lines.zh: 我在山谷和丛林之间来回。
lines.en: I pass back and forth between valley and jungle.

lines.zh: 我一扇翅，就越过一片树。
lines.en: One beat carries me over a stand of trees.
I circle above the treeline.

lines.zh: 我慢慢落到一根粗枝上。
lines.en: I settle slowly on a thick branch.
I ride the current upward.

lines.zh: 丛林深处有水声，我飞过去。
lines.en: Water sounds deep in the jungle; I fly to it.

lines.zh: 我贴着山壁滑行了一段。
lines.en: I glide a stretch along the cliff.

lines.zh: 我的影子在丛林上一闪。
lines.en: My shadow flickers across the canopy.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，又往高处飞。
lines.en: I bank and climb again.
I perch with my wings half open.
It is humid here. Little wind.
Birds are calling in the canopy.

lines.zh: 我的头冠在湿叶间发红。
lines.en: My crest shows red among the wet leaves.
There is a group of small beasts below.
I fold one wing slowly.
The branch shifts under me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看有没有上升气流。
lines.en: I look up for rising air.
The jungle mist has not lifted.
I lower my neck a little.
My long beak taps the trunk.

lines.zh: 我在等一天里最热的时候。
lines.en: I wait for the hottest part of the day.
I wipe the wood dust off my beak.
Damp has settled on the bark.
You are under the tree.
From the branch I see the top of your head.
I patrol this canopy.
Climbing up? You may try.
My wingspan is much taller than you.
I know every tree in this jungle.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，风送来了。
lines.en: The wind brought your scent.
I will not come down to you.
You walked beneath me.
I turned my head to watch you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看得清。
lines.en: I can see what you hold.

lines.zh: 我的翼一展就能走，你也追不上。
lines.en: One spread of my wings and I am gone.
My wing has been torn.
I land on a branch to steady myself.
Blood on the bark.

lines.zh: 我斜着穿过藤蔓才停住。
lines.en: I cut through the vines at an angle and stop.
I keep that in the wing bone.
I fold the wing over the wound.
I can still fly, with effort.
I move to a sturdier branch.
My breathing has grown heavy.
It is not time to come down.

lines.zh: 那点肉，比我平时的猎物小。
lines.en: That is smaller than my usual catch.
I drop lower to look.
That is not fresh.
I will not land for that.
It keeps moving. Good.

lines.zh: 我把头伸下去，又抬起来。
lines.en: I dip my head and raise it again.

lines.zh: 掉在树下的东西，我接了。
lines.en: I caught what fell below the tree.

lines.zh: 这点果肉，不够我啄两下。
lines.en: That much flesh is two pecks, no more.
I circled twice over its head.
I carry it to a branch to eat.
You touched only the tree.
I am on the branch, out of reach.
I tuck a wing to clear a branch.
You made the tree sway.
I move to a higher branch.
The tree can take that.
I sweep over you.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经飞了。
lines.en: By the time you look up I am gone.
I have landed on the far side.

lines.zh: 丛林上空，我绕着树冠飞。
lines.en: Over the jungle, I circle the canopy.
There are a few of us high in the jungle.

lines.zh: 我们在树冠上各自歇着。
lines.en: We rest apart in the canopy.
Their crests are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 有一只总在同一棵树上。
lines.en: One always uses the same tree.
We look at each other across a valley.
Neither crosses that valley.

lines.zh: 雾起来的时候，就都看不见了。
lines.en: When the mist rises we all vanish.
We only cross paths in the air.
This jungle holds us all.
We never nest together.
I take a fruit in my beak.
Too ripe. It burst at once.
This is wedged in a fork.
I hook it out with a foot.
Too heavy to carry up.

lines.zh: 我掉下去的东西，不要了。
lines.en: What I drop, I leave.
There is something shiny.
I look twice and leave it.
I drop it under the tree.

lines.zh: 这些，我一只爪都用不上。
lines.en: I would not spend a claw on these.
A shadow shifts under the tree.
I change perches.

lines.zh: 它一直低着头，没往上看。
lines.en: It keeps its head down and never looks up.

lines.zh: 这里的树冠把我遮住了。
lines.en: The canopy hides me here.
Slowly I open my wings.
I glide down toward it.
It has come into a clearing.
The wind is behind me from here.
I swoop down along the canopy line.
It heard the leaves move.
My shadow covers it first.
It looks up too late.
I fold my wings and drop on it.
Open ground this wide — nowhere to hide.
I follow above the canopy.
It weaves between the trunks.
I drop to treetop height.
I clear a crossing branch.

lines.zh: 它的影子在林地上很淡。
lines.en: Its shadow on the floor is faint.
I count the trees left.
It stopped to listen.
I hold still too.
It moves on.
The wind has given me away.
It bolted into the tree shadows.
It ran where I did not expect.
I change my angle.
The canopy is too tight to spread my wings.
I chase along the treetops.
It reached open ground.
Nothing blocks me now.
I dive straight from the canopy.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住了它的肩。
lines.en: My claws take its shoulder.
My beak strikes its neck.
It slipped behind the trunk.
I go round and strike again.

lines.zh: 我的翼边刮过它的下颌。
lines.en: My wing edge rakes its jaw.
I land on its back.
It throws me off.
I climb and bank half a turn.
That lands on its chest.
It backs into a tree.
I stand over it with wings folded.
My talons rake its calf.
It guards high; I come in low.
I fold a wing and drive it into its shoulder.
It rolls to the foot of a tree.
I glide down over the jungle.
The canopy of this tree is high.

lines.zh: 我的翼扫过叶面，露水落下。
lines.en: My wings brush the leaves and dew falls.
There is warm air rising here.
I settle on a branch and fold my wings.
The mist below has not lifted.
I flare the crest at my head.
This canopy is my ground.

lines.zh: 我看见山那边有一条谷。
lines.en: I can see a valley beyond the hills.
I fly a stretch along the treeline.
I land high and listen first.

lines.zh: 丛林里有湿土和腐叶的味道。
lines.en: The jungle smells of wet earth and rot.
I circle twice first.
The water here is off in the distance.
My shadow falls on the palms.
I set the angle of my wings.
Fire caught the membrane and I dropped.
The branch broke and I fell with it.
In water my wings are too heavy.
The blast tore the leaves away.
An arrow through my wing membrane. It leaks.

lines.zh: 怪力撑开我的翼，收不拢。
lines.en: Strange force spreads my wing open.

lines.zh: 丛林里没有可捕的，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Nothing to hunt here and I grow light.
Lightning struck and I stiffened.
The trees below are gone and I am falling.
